Workflows

Cleaning GBIF data

A table shaped like a GBIF download, from flagging every test to the retained records, with the catches checked against known errors.

Choosing a cleaning rule

What each test and each rule removes, by taxon, record age and coordinate precision, and how to apply the rule you choose.

Large tables on disk

Flag a directory of files too large for memory, tally from disk, join flags back to records and resume an interrupted run.

Running on several threads

Spread the outlier test and the proximity and polygon queries over several threads, check that the flags stay the same, read the measured speedup and set up OpenMP on each platform.

Cleaning fossil records

The age tests and PyRate export for Paleobiology Database records.

Custom reference points and polygons

Replace the reference points or polygons of one test with your own, including species range maps.

Reference data
